question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I am well aware _________ all the mishaps.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"of"** is a preposition used to show possession, belonging, or a connection between things. (का, की, के)

 
 
• **Example:** The cover** of** the book is blue.
 
 
 
• **"Aware"** means having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact. (सचेत)
 
 
• **Example:** She is **aware** of the rules and regulations.
 
 
 
• Hence, "aware of" is the correct combination to use in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **With** (के साथ): Used to indicate being together or being involved.

 
 
• **Example:** She came with her friends.
 
 
 
• **From** (से): Used to indicate the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.
 
 
• **Example:** He came from the market.
 
 
 
• **By** (द्वारा): Used to indicate the agent performing the action.
 
 
• **Example:** The book was written by him.
